title: Horizon City
summary: Xiao Yan sets out for the Central Plains with Zi Yan, Xin Lan and the Little Fairy Doctor, and on the way Xin Lan lists the great factions: one hall, one tower, two sects, three valleys and four pavilions. At Horizon City in the Tianqing Mountain Range, the Wormhole is shut for repairs by the Luo family. The Little Fairy Doctor humbles the spoiled Xiao Yao, and her grandfather, City Lord Luo Cheng, backs down and hires the group to help fix the Wormhole for a Rank Six Sky Poison Dragon Scorpion Beast core. During the repair the Two Han Elders cut their power to save themselves, and the array goes out of control. The Wormhole is saved, and Luo Cheng thanks the Little Fairy Doctor. He gives Xiao Yan the promised payment and a space ship stocked with herbs, and the group sets off for the Central Plains.
events: On the way to Horizon City, Xin Lan explains the factions of the Central Plains.
The Wormhole is closed; the Luo family is repairing it.
The Little Fairy Doctor humbles Xiao Yao, granddaughter of City Lord Luo Cheng.
Luo Cheng offers a Rank Six Sky Poison Dragon Scorpion Beast core for help repairing the Wormhole.
The Two Han Elders reduce their output and the array goes out of control.
The Wormhole is saved and Luo Cheng thanks the Little Fairy Doctor.
Luo Cheng gives the group a space ship loaded with herbs and they set off.
cultivation: Luo Cheng is about Five-Star Dou Zong. Xiao Yan is called a Dou Huang; the Little Fairy Doctor is recognized as a Dou Zong.
